scenario: [LNUL.4.9] the NaN subject, over a NaN the rule computes rather than one the harness asserts — which is the only way to reach it. [LEXP.4.2] rejects a NaN arriving at assert with DS_ERR_NAN_REJECTED, so a NaN slot value cannot be set up; but inf is a permitted Float and no float operation checks finiteness, so `s.state - s.state` over inf produces NaN inside the expression. Drives the eval arm with subject IS_SUBJECT_NAN over that computed value; the rule FIRES. This also pins the reachability finding the model rests on: if NaN were genuinely unproducible, this fixture could not be written, and the NaN subject would be dead surface. fact_count 2.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.state - s.state is NaN
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: s.entity_id
